Pixel Agents renderer integration

Pinned commit: b1bafd02896d90d83457266575a1e8e5011ce997 (v1.5.0)
Renderer code: MIT License, Copyright (c) 2026 Pablo De Lucca. See LICENSE.

Character atlases char_0.png through char_5.png are the upstream's adaptations
of MetroCity by JIK-A-4, Creative Commons Zero v1.0 Universal:
https://jik-a-4.itch.io/metrocity-free-topdown-character-pack
https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/
Upstream attribution: README.md at the pinned commit, “Diverse characters”.
The original creator permits commercial use and appreciates attribution.

Quantara supplies its own desk/chair pixel definitions and office layout.
No upstream furniture, floors, walls, pet packs or third-party asset libraries
are distributed. The renderer's original MIT bubble definitions are included.

Only the client canvas renderer and character assets are reused. Upstream
App, transports, server, terminal, hooks, transcript readers and browserMock
are excluded. Canvas activity is driven by recorded Quantara research steps.
